name: Soft Boiled Eggs
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Bring about 1 inch of water to a rolling boil in a saucepan. You want just enough water to create steam but not evaporate completely.
Gently add the eggs, then cover with a lid.
Let boil/steam for 6–6½ minutes, depending on how runny you want the yolks.
Immediately remove pot from heat, and drain the hot water.

culture.text: Boiled eggs are a food typically made using chicken eggs. They are cooked with their shells unbroken, usually by immersion in boiling water. Hard-boiled or hard-cooked eggs are cooked so that the egg white and egg yolk both solidify, while soft-boiled eggs may leave the yolk, and sometimes the white, at least partially liquid. Boiled eggs are a popular breakfast food around the world.
